title: seriphidium kaschgaricum var. dshungaricum
intro: Seriphidium kaschgaricum var. dshungaricum, commonly known as Dshungaricum or Dzungaricum, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its adaptogenic and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a sought-after remedy in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Seriphidium kaschgaricum var. dshungaricum include reducing stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
